notes: This is a 300W LED moving-head spot fixture (automated lighting), not a conventional AV signal-chain device — none of the taxonomy category/type options fit well, so "other" was used for both. No RJ45, no built-in wireless DMX (W-DMX), and not rack-mountable (desktop/truss/omega-bracket mounted, 47.8 lb, 16.1x13.5x19.25in). Rear panel (per official user manual, Rev. 3) has two DMX connector pairs, each offering a 3-pin XLR and 5-pin XLR socket, functioning as one logical DMX In and one logical DMX Out (RDM-enabled, 18 or 21 selectable DMX channels). Power is Neutrik powerCON A in/out (auto-ranging 100-240VAC 50/60Hz); ships with Edison-to-powerCON cord (US) or local-plug equivalent worldwide; fuse F7A/250V. No grade applied to any port — DMX/XLR and powerCON connectors are outside the given bandwidth-grade scales. Verified against both the manufacturer product page (chauvetprofessional.com) and the official Chauvet Rogue R2X Spot User Manual Rev. 3 (rear-panel diagram + Technical Specifications table), which agree on all connector counts/types.
